events.title: Demo update - Steam Deck support, new relics and quality-of-life
events.summary: This update adds official Steam Deck support, keyboard and controller controls, new content, and improvements to combat, menus and performance. Steam Deck, Keyboard and Controllers Added official Steam Deck support, with controller navigation and Deck-specific button prompts. Added keyboard and controller navigation throughout battles, maps, shops, events, rewards and tutorials. Added selection highlights, device-specific hints and a Controls page in Settings. events.summary: Expanded the demo from 10 to 20 supported languages: English, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish (Latin America), Spanish (Spain), Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese.Added the Five of a Kind relic combo and reworked several higher-level combos.Rebalanced various cards, relics, statuses, and rewards.Improved combat effects, feedback, targeting, and card resolution.
